threshold_justification: Synthetic-only analytical threshold: relative health 0.85 (= 15% decline from documented clean-by-construction reference). Selected for reproducible threshold-crossing evaluation on the brackish demonstration domain. Not a FilmTec/manufacturer cleaning trigger; not a plant-validated limit.
train_dev_test_note: Scenario groups (train/development/test) were defined in configs/synthetic_benchmark.yaml before baseline evaluation. Baselines are not fitted; trend window taken from config (development-facing). No tuning on the final test set. Prior inspected Phase 3 scores were not used to retune the simulator for a preferred model.
corrective_pass_note: Phase 3 corrective pass regenerated these baselines after evaluation/physics/CSV fixes. Not a trained-model submission. Does not claim real-plant validation.
disclaimer: Synthetic benchmark performance does not establish plant accuracy.
